title: auth.signup_attribution
description: The advertising click an account was born from, or null. Returns {"user_id", "click_id", "click_id_type": gclid|gbraid|wbraid, "captured_at", "utm": {source, medium, campaign, term, content}, "created_at", "updated_at"} for an account whose registration request carried an attribution object, and null for every other account — which is the ordinary answer, not an error. The read side of stapel_auth.attribution: it is a Function and not an endpoint because the caller is a service (billing, a subscription job) that has to report an offline conversion weeks after the browser that produced the click is gone; a front end has no use for the identifier and every reason not to hold it. An unparseable user_id answers null for the same reason a missing one does.

user_id.description: Primary key of the account whose signup attribution is read.
